title: marlierea skortzoviana

It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against various diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disorders. The therapeutic actions of Marlierea skortzoviana are thought to be due to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a promising candidate for the treatment of infections and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Marlierea skortzoviana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
